decisions.title: Approved A scope, reuse and exact focus targeting
decisions.body:
Date: 2026-10-26
This canonical decision records the pre-existing prose rulings without changing approved scope: Avi selected A and AUTO in session_turn:codex:01a1766c-644c-7213-9563-e4c98ef3ad8b:22 after requesting a separate popup with report and exact agent-window access in turns2 and9. Work directly in this session. Extend the existing native Quick Panel; retain its persisted opt-in shortcut, existing tools and singleton lifecycle. Reuse canonical queries, report authorization, conversation transport and focus actions. Reports and conversations remain inside the popup. For exact focus, the launcher must pass the observed window or launch identity and omit a shared terminal-server PID: inspection of adv-session-focus.ts shows PID resolution precedes identity title fallbacks, so a shared PID cannot establish the selected window.
